passages.provision_quote: the division shall not approve any notice of intention under Section 3203 within a health protection zone, except for approvals of notices of intention necessary for any of the following purposes
passages.note: Bars new-drilling NOI approvals only within 3,200-foot health protection zones; drilling elsewhere remains permitted, so it shows anti-expansion direction without matching a specific rung's full scope.

rows.reasoning: As author of SB 1137 (signed 2022-09-16), Gonzalez barred the division from approving new drilling notices of intention within 3,200-foot health protection zones around homes, schools and similar sensitive receptors, showing opposition to new drilling near populated areas. But the bill leaves drilling approvals outside those zones untouched, so it does not establish 'Allow no new drilling and let production decline over time' (rung 2) over 'Keep fossil fuel production steady at current levels' (rung 3) or 'Phase out fossil fuel production entirely' (rung 1) — it shows only the restrictive direction, not which rung.
needs_source: Gonzalez's own statement describing her overall position on statewide/national fossil fuel production levels, or a record establishing a statewide (not zone-limited) new-drilling policy
